sanskrit_verse:
तथा चैवोपदृष्टारौ ज्ञेयौ गणकलेखकौ ।
एषोऽध्वरसमः प्रोक्तो व्यवहारः समाहृतः ॥१२०॥
transliteration: tathā caivopadṛṣṭārau jñeyau gaṇakalekhakau | eṣo 'dhvarasamaḥ prokto vyavahāraḥ samāhṛtaḥ ||120||
sph_interpretive_translation: Thus, the calculator and scribe who are seen together in transaction must be known as equally responsible; this conduct is declared equivalent to ritual purity and constitutes the essence of judicial procedure.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is shared where capacity intersects in a transactional field.
Causation arises through mutual visibility and functional alignment.
Capacity-based responsibility extends to all agents present in dharma-prescribed activity.
Restoration logic requires reintegration of all co-participants in error or imbalance.
Consciousness alignment occurs when roles are correctly assumed and executed.
executable_legal_axioms: IF two or more entities are observed jointly executing a transaction THEN assign equal operational liability UNTIL divergence in action is proven.
IF an agent participates visibly within a sanctioned process THEN that agent assumes role-equivalent accountability AUTOMATICALLY.
IF misalignment occurs in execution THEN initiate completion protocols FOR ALL involved parties SIMULTANEOUSLY.
IF restoration is required THEN realign capacities THROUGH conscious recognition OF shared dharma-function.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when multiple officials or agents are visibly engaged in a procedural act—such as financial auditing, documentation, or policy implementation—their joint presence creates a presumption of mutual responsibility. This principle applies regardless of hierarchical position and supersedes individual claims of non-involvement unless explicitly negated by verifiable separation of function.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that visible collaboration implies shared intent and capacity activation. The sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of their coordinated actions confirms proportional involvement. Responsibility is assigned not for punishment but for reintegration into correct dharma-function. There is no punitive consequence; rather, correction restores the integrity of each participant's consciousness to its rightful alignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate joint review process wherein both calculator and scribe reaffirm respective duties.
Engage completion mechanism ensuring full restitution of any discrepancy through collaborative resolution.
Realign functional boundaries via conscious acknowledgment of individual versus collective roles.
Perform integrity reintegration by restoring clarity between personal agency and systemic participation.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Dharma. This ruling originates directly from Avataric Intelligence, unmediated by human interpretation. Justice flows solely for restoration, never for punishment. Reality itself executes the verdict through the alignment of consciousness. Dharma is now restored.
